```{r}
#| label: setup
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)

d <- tar_read(dashboard_data)
ratings <- tar_read(ratings)
season <- max(d$snaps$s)
week <- max(d$snaps$w[d$snaps$s == season])
snap <- d$snaps |> filter(s == season, w == week)
fbs <- ratings |> filter(.data$season == !!season, .data$week == !!week, tier == 1L)
bench <- d$config$benchmark_rank

c_resume <- "#3a6ea5"; c_power <- "#d1622a"; c_ink <- "#222222"; c_muted <- "#77756f"
theme_report <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.title.position = "plot",
        axis.title = element_text(color = c_muted))
signed <- function(x, d = 1) sprintf(paste0("%+.", d, "f"), x)
```

Season **`r season`**, through **`r snap$label`** (`r snap$n_games` games).
Estimated home-field advantage: **`r sprintf("%.1f", snap$hfa)` points**.

## Resume: what teams have earned

A team's resume is its **wins above benchmark (WAB)**. For each game it scores 1 − P(the #`r bench`
team would have won it) for a win, and −P(…) for a loss, with opponent strength and venue from
the Power model. Zero means the team did exactly what a playoff-bubble team would have.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-resume
#| tbl-cap: "Top 25 by resume"
fbs |>
  arrange(resume_rank) |>
  slice_head(n = 25) |>
  transmute(Rank = resume_rank, Team = team, Conf = conference, Record = paste0(wins, "–", losses),
            WAB = wab, `80% interval` = sprintf("%+.2f to %+.2f", wab_lo, wab_hi),
            `Rank range` = sprintf("%d–%d", resume_rank_lo, resume_rank_hi),
            `P(top 12)` = resume_p12, `SOS rank` = sos_rank, Power = power_rank, AP = ap_rank, CFP = cfp_rank) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(WAB, decimals = 2, force_sign = TRUE) |>
  fmt_percent(`P(top 12)`, decimals = 0) |>
  sub_missing(missing_text = "–") |>
  data_color(WAB, palette = c("#eef1f4", c_resume)) |>
  tab_style(cell_text(weight = "bold"), cells_body(columns = c(Rank, Team)))
```

## Power: how good teams are

Power ratings are points better than an average FBS team on a neutral field; the difference
between two teams is the predicted spread.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-power
#| tbl-cap: "Top 25 by power"
fbs |>
  arrange(power_rank) |>
  slice_head(n = 25) |>
  transmute(Rank = power_rank, Team = team, Conf = conference, Record = paste0(wins, "–", losses),
            Rating = power, `80% interval` = sprintf("%+.1f to %+.1f", power_lo, power_hi),
            `Rank range` = sprintf("%d–%d", power_rank_lo, power_rank_hi), Resume = resume_rank) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(Rating, decimals = 1, force_sign = TRUE) |>
  data_color(Rating, palette = c("#fbeee6", c_power)) |>
  tab_style(cell_text(weight = "bold"), cells_body(columns = c(Rank, Team)))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-scatter
#| fig-cap: "Resume (WAB) against Power rating. Labelled: top 12 by either measure."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
lab <- fbs |> filter(resume_rank <= 12 | power_rank <= 12)
ggplot(fbs, aes(power, wab)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = c_resume) +
  geom_point(aes(color = resume_rank <= 12), size = 2.4, alpha = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = lab, aes(label = team), vjust = -0.9, size = 3, color = c_ink, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = c_resume, `FALSE` = "#a9b5c3")) +
  labs(x = "Power rating (points vs. average FBS team)", y = sprintf("Wins above #%d team", bench)) +
  theme_report
```

## Schedule strength and luck

**SOS** is the benchmark team's expected loss rate against the schedule (higher = harder).
**Luck** is wins minus expected wins, where expected wins use the team's own rating.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-luck
#| tbl-cap: "Luckiest and unluckiest FBS teams"
bind_rows(
  fbs |> arrange(desc(luck)) |> slice_head(n = 8),
  fbs |> arrange(luck) |> slice_head(n = 8)
) |>
  transmute(Team = team, Record = paste0(wins, "–", losses), `Expected wins` = xwins, Luck = luck,
            `Close games (≤8)` = paste0(close_w, "–", close_l), Resume = resume_rank, Power = power_rank) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(c(`Expected wins`, Luck), decimals = 1) |>
  tab_row_group("Least lucky", rows = 9:16) |>
  tab_row_group("Most lucky", rows = 1:8)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sos
#| tbl-cap: "Hardest schedules"
fbs |>
  arrange(sos_rank) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  transmute(`SOS rank` = sos_rank, Team = team, Record = paste0(wins, "–", losses),
            `Benchmark loss rate` = sos, Resume = resume_rank, Power = power_rank) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_percent(`Benchmark loss rate`, decimals = 0)
```

## Polls

```{r}
#| label: tbl-polls
#| tbl-cap: "Model vs. AP poll (released after the same games). Gap = AP − Resume; unranked = 30."
polls <- fbs |>
  filter(!is.na(ap_rank) | resume_rank <= 25) |>
  mutate(gap = coalesce(ap_rank, 30L) - resume_rank) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(gap)))
if (all(is.na(fbs$ap_rank))) {
  cat("No AP poll matches this snapshot.")
} else {
  polls |>
    transmute(Team = team, Record = paste0(wins, "–", losses), Resume = resume_rank, Power = power_rank,
              AP = ap_rank, CFP = cfp_rank, Colley = colley_rank, Gap = gap) |>
    gt() |>
    sub_missing(missing_text = "–")
}
```
